title: Sensei Governed Evaluator Composition Evaluation Input V1
description: The exact, closed input one evaluator invocation binds to: O1 Session digest, accepted Attempt digest, candidate artifact digest, repository domain/base revision, plan generation/attempt number, a disposable evaluator-surface reference, the precommitted deadline and evidence limits, and the required proof-obligation digests relevant to this session.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/evaluatorcomposition. evaluator_surface_ref is an opaque reference to a fresh, disposable per-evaluator materialization -- checkpoint 2 defines only its shape as data; checkpoint 4 gives it real filesystem-backed meaning.

evaluation_input_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.
